description: This file defines data models and type annotations for handling chat completion messages, including system, user, assistant, tool, and function messages, as well as a request model for a chat completion API.

classes.name: ChatCompletionSystemMessageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for system message parameters with content, role, and optional name.

classes.name: ChatCompletionContentPartTextParam
classes.description: TypedDict for text content parts with text and type.

classes.name: ImageURL
classes.description: TypedDict for image URL with optional detail level.

classes.name: ChatCompletionContentPartImageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for image content parts with image_url and type.

classes.name: ChatCompletionUserMessageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for user message parameters with content, role, and optional name.

classes.name: FunctionCall
classes.description: TypedDict for function call arguments and name.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: TypedDict for function arguments and name.

classes.name: ChatCompletionToolMessageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for tool message parameters with content, role, and tool_call_id.

classes.name: ChatCompletionFunctionMessageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for function message parameters with content, name, and role.

classes.name: ChatCompletionMessageToolCallParam
classes.description: TypedDict for tool call message with id, function, and type.

classes.name: ChatCompletionAssistantMessageParam
classes.description: TypedDict for assistant message with role, optional content, function_call, name, and tool_calls.

classes.name: CompletionRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for chat completion API request with various parameters.
